correctness.rationale: Every nonzero integer frequency and all n>=2 are covered: the projection H=I-11^T/n plus exact Haar fourth-character identity gives the four covariance cases, including the all-equal-index correction and boundary n=2. Explicit finite contractions T_parallel=(n-1)(n^3-2n^2-n+3)/n^2 and T_cross=-(n-1)(n-3)/n^2 yield normalized coefficients. A complete pair count proves the grid variance. The included Laurent checker independently obtained 33 exact rational fourth-moment comparisons at n=2,3,4, plus 12 combinatorial variance checks; all passed. These finite checks corroborate but do not replace the general analytic proof.

value.rationale: A rectangular signed-frequency sum is a natural truncation of the circular empirical-characteristic-function independence statistic. Its exact finite-null variance identifies small positive covariance between scores sharing a marginal frequency, distinguishes coordinate sign reversals, and shows a frequency-budget crossover at P+Q on the order n^2. This directly refines the second-moment calibration of many-frequency diagnostics, without claiming quantile validity or a distributional theorem.
